items.t: Co-chaired the Michigan Joint Task Force on Jail and Pretrial Incarceration, which was created in April 2019 by Executive Order No. 2019-10 (2019).
items.q: In April 2019, Governor Whitmer signed Executive Order No. 2019-10 creating the Michigan Joint Task Force on Jail and Pretrial Incarceration co-chaired by Lieutenant Governor Garlin Gilchrist and Chief Justice Bridget Mary McCormack.

items.t: Has championed criminal justice reform since taking office.
